lessons.example: I can use health English in a new situation.
context: Daniel meets Sara at a cafe.
Weigh the pros and cons before you decide. Make up your mind soon.
dialogue: Daniel: Sara, do you have a health question?
Sara: Yes. The doctor talked about a gene in my family.
Daniel: Good. Weigh the pros and cons before you decide.
Sara: Yes. Her hypothesis was right.
Daniel: True. Play it safe and see a doctor.
Sara: Good. I will make up my mind soon.

lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about health in a new situation. Say what you did and how it ended.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Anna, I want to tell you about health in a new situation. On Monday, Daniel met Sara at a cafe. Sara said, 'The doctor talked about a gene in my family. Weigh the pros and cons before you decide.' Her hypothesis was right. Play it safe and see a doctor. A gene can run in a family, so play it safe. I will make up my mind soon and play it safe. Please tell me about your work. Best, Sara
lessons.sound: Gene has its strongest beat on GENE. In gene, say GENE clearly. In hypothesis, say POTH clearly in the middle.
lessons.model: The gene came from her mother.
